purpose: Three separate shape-first references for owner Tripo generation; textures to be made later.

generations.prompt:
Create ONE clean high-resolution SINGLE-OBJECT 3D MODELING REFERENCE IMAGE for Tripo image-to-3D. Use the supplied Bloomlings wardrobe sheet ONLY to identify the selected item from the SPRIG SUMMER cell (first hero column, first seasonal row). Extract and faithfully develop that one item's shape into a standalone large product render. Do NOT reproduce the catalog, grid, character, text, labels, other items or multiple views.

The owner wants GEOMETRY FIRST; textures will be made separately. Render all solid parts in the SAME LIGHT NEUTRAL GRAY clay material, without color blocking, without green or cream or yellow colors. Smooth matte sculpted surfaces, all details actual relief geometry, not painted texture. Soft neutral bright studio lighting, subtle ambient occlusion to clarify part boundaries, very light grounding shadow, plain white background. Entire object centered on a SQUARE canvas with generous margins, fills around 80% of frame. Clean orthographic three-quarter product view with minimal perspective distortion. Premium rounded stylized game accessory, clear buildable forms, moderate thick edges, no microscopic details. No cloth weave, photoreal grain, embroidery, decorative stitches, dirt, wear, text, logo, hanging tag, props, stand, mannequin or human anatomy. No new ornaments beyond specified.

SELECT the small GREEN DAISY BASEBALL CAP from Sprig's SUMMER cell, not any other hat. Single cap, front three-quarter view slightly above brim, turned so the daisy on the near side is clearly visible.
Shape: low softly domed crown, oval open lower rim, front-to-back length slightly greater than width; crown height about half crown width. Five broad smooth panel surfaces separated only by shallow clean grooves, converging at a tiny low round button on top. Not puffy segmented pillows. Hollow crown with consistent thin shell thickness and a narrow inner rim, visibly an empty wearable cap. Back has a small inverted-U adjustment opening and one simple broad strap, no tiny hardware.
Bill: broad short U-shaped rounded visor projecting forward by about one-third crown width. Visor width slightly less than crown width, shallow transverse curve with center a little higher than side edges, front edge gently downturned. Consistent visible modest thickness and softly beveled edge. Seamless clean crown-to-bill junction, not a separate floating plate, no holes.
Daisy: one SMALL raised daisy on the near front-side panel directly above bill, about one-quarter crown width. EXACTLY FIVE plump broad oval petals and ONE round low domed central disk, all same gray as cap. Petals widen toward their rounded tips, slightly overlap at base, form one neat radial ring. Petals and center remain readable as modeled forms without color. Daisy is attached flush to crown, no stem or extra leaf.
Preserve compact friendly silhouette of the sheet, not a long-brim baseball cap or tall human hat.

Front three-quarter product view with only a modest horizontal angle so BOTH ROUND LENS OPENINGS, bridge and both backward-pointing temples can be understood clearly. Temple arms spread naturally, no crossed arms.
Two identical truly round circular rims, symmetrically aligned on one level. Moderate chunky rounded-rectangle rim cross-section with soft edges. Lens opening diameter about 80 percent of outside rim diameter; central gap between rims about 20 percent of one outside rim diameter. No cat-eye corners, no oval lenses, no flat goggles mask. Front assembly has a very slight curve wrapping back at outer edges.
Bridge is a short smooth gently raised arch connecting inner upper-quarter areas of the rims. Clear open nose space beneath bridge, no human nose or nose pads. Two circular thin gently convex lens inserts sit slightly recessed behind front rim edges. LENSES ARE CLEAR NEUTRAL TRANSLUCENT GRAY with very faint reflection, no green tint, no dark opaque fill, no eyes or painted highlights. All frame solid parts share same matte light gray material. Lens inserts must remain thin sheets, not bulging marbles.
One simple small hinge block at each outer rim edge, no screws. Two broad smooth temple arms go backward, mildly tapering, about 1.2 times one rim diameter long, with last quarter curving gently downward and rounded tips. Continuous neat construction, temples connect only to hinges, not glass centers. No daisy or leaf ornament on glasses. No face, head or mannequin.

Compact upright rounded rectangular main body, height about 1.2 times width, depth about half width. Broad nearly flat base with rounded corners, gently domed top shoulders. Front only slightly convex, not ballooned, not spherical or barrel-shaped. Back flatter for wearing. Side panels smooth and compact.
Wide upper flap covers top and descends to around middle of front. Flap consists of TWO broad overlapping stylized LEAVES meeting in a neat soft V, faithful to reference. Leaves broad at upper roots taper toward short rounded points, no spikes or serration. Slight raised edge separates flap from body. One broad shallow central vein per leaf, at most two gently suggested side folds, no realistic fine vein networks.

One raised DAISY centered on pocket, about one-third body width. Daisy has EXACTLY FIVE plump rounded oval petals around ONE small domed round central disk. Same gray clay as entire backpack, no painted details, no stem or extra ornaments.
Two separate identical broad flat SHOULDER STRAPS attach near upper back corners and lower back. Straps form smooth untwisted open loops with visible air gap between each loop and backpack rear, moderate thickness and rounded edges. Do not fuse straps to back surface or fill their holes. No crossbody strap, dangling belts or buckles.
One SHORT TOP HANDLE centered at top, inverted-U broad strap loop with clearly open hole beneath it, smaller than shoulder loops. Handle joins body at two distinct attachment points. No extra handles. The backpack has clean joined parts and shallow panel borders only, no zipper teeth, seam stitches, metal fittings or extra pockets. Preserve the little nature-themed backpack's shape, not a human hiking pack.
